label: AF3 code + OpenFold3 openbind weights, no templates
notes: af3_openbind.json with use_templates flipped to false. Nothing else differs, so
the pair (af3_openbind, af3_openbind_templateoff) isolates the effect of the
templates alone: same code, same weights, same MSAs, same seed, same GPU type.
AlphaFold3 has no flag that turns templates off at inference (see af3_native.json),
so slurm/predict.sbatch applies use_templates=false by writing a scratch copy of
the input JSON with `templates: []` in every protein entity — AlphaFold3's explicit
'use no templates' value, as opposed to a null/absent `templates`, which under
--norun_data_pipeline would mean 'unfilled'. The shared work/af3_input/ tree is read
only, so both arms run off the same MSAs by construction and the number of templates
actually dropped is recorded per entry in _profiling/<entry>.meta.json.
This arm is also the one matched to of3_openbind_templateoff.json: the OF3
converter carries no templates over, so a like-for-like code comparison needs the
AF3 side run without them too.
